# `arch/include/arch/asid.h`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Address Space Identifier (ASID) functionality.

```c
#include <arch/asid.h>
```

## Structures

### `AsidToken` { #asidtoken }

Represents an ASID token (with an ASID and its generation.).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `asid` | [`Asid`](../../arm/include/arch_impl/asid.md#asid) | ASID value. |
| `generation` | `uint32_t` | Its generation. |

## Functions

### `AsidAlloc` { #asidalloc }

```c
AsidToken AsidAlloc(void);
```

Allocate a new ASID token.

**Returns:** [AsidToken](#asidtoken)

### `AsidFree` { #asidfree }

```c
void AsidFree(AsidToken token);
```

Let go of an existing ASID token.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `token` | in | Token from AsidAlloc(); a token from an older generation is ignored. |

### `AsidSetActive` { #asidsetactive }

```c
void AsidSetActive(Asid asid);
```

Activates the provided ASID by marking it on the ASID bitmap.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `asid` | in | ASID now loaded on the CPU. |
